title: Docs: the boot-recovery overall line is emitted only when the boot plan has at least one target
outcome: docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (about line 3163, Recovery diagnostics) says unconditionally that the boot-recovery coordinator "emits an overall line with elapsed time, budget, outcome, and unfinished count". Since w-b3f0058feb49, recover_prepared_engram_sessions_after_boot returns before any clock, worker or channel when the plan has no targets, so a boot with no recovery targets prints no overall line. That was the change's one stated behaviour change, concurred under its criterion 2. Qualify the sentence: the overall line is emitted when the plan has at least one target. Docs only; no code change.
acceptance: Docs: the boot-recovery overall line is emitted only when the boot plan has at least one target is done
